# Hikes in Japan

> > Comprehensive guide to Japan's best hiking trails, from beginner-friendly day hikes near Tokyo to multi-day alpine treks in the Japanese Alps and Yakushima's ancient cedar forests.

Hikes in Japan provides detailed trail guides organized by region, difficulty, and duration, covering iconic mountains like Mt. Fuji and Mt. Takao, as well as remote wilderness areas in Hokkaido, the Northern and Southern Japanese Alps, and Kyushu. The site includes essential information about Japan's mountain climate, seasons, and hiking safety.

## Key Topics

- Mt. Fuji
- Mt. Takao
- Northern Japanese Alps
- Southern Japanese Alps
- Yakushima
- Rokko Mountains
- Day hikes from Tokyo
- Multi-day alpine treks
- Mountain hut stays
- Ridge traverses
- Beginner-friendly trails
- Alpine flowers
- Japan mountain seasons
- Hot spring access trails

## Getting Started

- [HIKES IN JAPAN - Let's Walk Japan's Best Trails](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com): Homepage for Japan's best hiking trails and course guides
- [Browse Hiking Areas](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/area): Browse hiking courses by region including Japanese Alps and Hokkaido
- [Featured Trail Collections](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/feature): Browse hiking trails by themed categories and destinations
- [Essential Hiking Information](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/information): Essential hiking information for safety and preparation in Japan
- [Japan's Nature, Climate, and Seasons](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/information/e.php): Guide to Japan's mountain climate, seasons, and hiking conditions

## Day Hikes from Tokyo

- [Day Hikes from Tokyo Collection](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/feature/1.php): Curated day hikes accessible from Tokyo via railway lines
- [Mt. Takao to Mt. Jinba Traverse](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/3.php): Beginner-friendly Mt. Takao to Mt. Jinba traverse near Tokyo

## Northern Japanese Alps

- [Hakuba Sanzan (Three Peaks)](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/46.php): Hakuba three peaks via Daisekkei snow patch in Northern Alps
- [Mt. Tsubakuro from Nakabusa Onsen](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/34.php): Popular Northern Alps Mt. Tsubakuro from Nakabusa Onsen in 2 days
- [Mt. Tanigawa, Tenjin-one Ridge](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/19.php): Mt. Tanigawa via ropeway-accessed Tenjin-one Ridge route

## Southern Japanese Alps & Central Mountains

- [Mt. Kitadake Loop from Hirogawara](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/49.php): Loop course of Japan's 2nd highest peak in Southern Alps
- [Mt. Amigasa and Mt. Gongen Loop](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/60.php): Multi-day loop through Southern Yatsugatake's Mt. Amigasa & Mt. Gongen
- [Mt. Kobushigatake via Tokuchan-Shindo Trail](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/78.php): Mt. Kobushigatake main peak via Tokuchan-Shindo Trail in Okuchichibu
- [Nasu Circuit of Mt. Chausu and Mt. Asahi](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/28.php): Mt. Nasu loop covering volcanic Mt. Chausu and Mt. Asahi peaks

## Yakushima Island

- [Shiratani Unsuikyo Trekking](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/136.php): Yakushima's Shiratani Unsuikyo trail through ancient cedar forest
- [Mt. Miyanoura from Yodogawa Trailhead](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/141.php): Yakushima's highest peak Mt. Miyanoura day hike from Yodogawa

## Kobe & Rokko Mountains

- [Mt. Maya via Tengu Trail](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/93.php): Mt. Maya via challenging Tengu Trail in Kobe's Rokko Mountains
- [Ashiya Rock Garden to Arima Onsen](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/91.php): Popular Rokko Mountains route ending at Arima Onsen hot spring

## Northern Japan & Hokkaido

- [Mt. Iwate Traverse](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/64.php): Mt. Iwate active volcano traverse via Yakehashiri route
- [Mt. Rausu from Iwaobetsu Onsen](https://hikesinjapan.yamakei-online.com/course/134.php): Shiretoko's highest peak Mt. Rausu from Iwaobetsu Onsen trailhead
